48.original: Ah, your timing is quite fortuitous. I have a task that could make use of one with your expertise.

49.original: Since beginning our vigil after the fall of Ronka, we Viis have seldom ventured beyond the bounds of Yx'Maja.

50.original: But times are changing, and it has come to our attention that the ruins beneath Lake Tusi Mek'ta remain untouched by the Blessed.

51.original: Being more familiar with the environs of the west, I think you would be well suited to the endeavor.

52.original: According to our records, there are several owl statues somewhere within the ruins. I ask that you find them and ensure they yet remain whole.

53.original: You are familiar with Lake Tusi Mek'ta, yes? Then this survey should prove no trouble at all.

54.original: You find nothing out of the ordinary.

55.original: The beak of the owl statue appears to be chipped.

56.original: The statue appears to be covered in algae. You gingerly wipe it away.

58.original: You wiped them as well? I'd expect nothing less from an ally of Ronka, and a fellow Viis at that.

59.original: You wiped them as well? I'd expect nothing less from an ally of Ronka.

60.original: In the days of the Ronkan Empire, the owl was regarded with great reverence. The divine beast of night and keeper of knowledge.

61.original: In fact, there is a legend that speaks of a time when darkness fades and the people pray for night. An owl is said to guide <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> who heralds the night's return.

62.original: Perhaps that is why fate brings you here.
